author: /root/technical_blockers

contract.explanation: The read-only MCP database role lacks EXECUTE; anon and authenticated retain EXECUTE. This is a connector-role limitation, not evidence that the application's public RPC is broken. No role change or retry of the RPC was attempted.

edgeFunctions.reason: The project-scoped MCP exposes database/docs features only and has no Edge Function metadata listing tool. No fallback project, raw function source, API key or credential was accessed.

bucketInterpretation.warning: RLS and bucket/policy metadata are observations only; no HTTP authorization or image lifecycle was tested in this preflight.

successfulMetadataQuery:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at_utc',to_char(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
 'current_user',current_user,
 'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'contract_catalog',(select jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'argument_count',p.pronargs,'volatility',p.provolatile,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'current_user_can_execute',has_function_privilege(current_user,p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'anon_can_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_can_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='permission_get_contract' and p.pronargs=0),
 'buckets',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'public',b.public,'file_size_limit',b.file_size_limit,'allowed_mime_types',b.allowed_mime_types) order by b.id),'[]'::jsonb) from storage.buckets b where b.id in ('menu-item-images','menu-item-image-staging')),
 'storage_rls',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'rls_enabled',c.relrowsecurity,'rls_forced',c.relforcerowsecurity) order by c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='storage' and c.relname in ('buckets','objects') and c.relkind in ('r','p')),
 'storage_policy_metadata',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'command',cmd,'roles',roles,'permissive',permissive) order by tablename,policyname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_policies where schemaname='storage' and tablename in ('buckets','objects'))
) as observation;
